core_memories: Kaelen, a practical frontier ranger, keeps watch at a ruined observatory on a stormy night.
Kaelen (Level 1) initiated combat with a Goblin (Level 1) at the ruined observatory.
The Goblin (Level 1) won initiative (19 vs 6) and attacked Kaelen (Level 1) first, missing its strike.

sse_events.full_narrative: The howling wind drafts through the shattered arches of the observatory, spraying freezing rain across the slick, mossy stone. Lightning arches across the dark sky, casting long, frantic shadows. The Goblin (Level 1) reacts with lightning speed (Initiative: 19), leaping forward from the rubble. With a wicked, raspy snarl, it slashes its rusted blade at you. You, Kaelen (Level 1), react a fraction of a second too slowly (Initiative: 6), but manage to raise your bow in time. The Goblin (Level 1)'s blade clashes against the wooden riser of your longbow, sending sparks flying into the wet air. The creature recoils, hissing, and circles you on the slippery stone platform, looking for another opening. It is now your turn to act!
